formal: I have found a flat advertised online that is cheaper than any other in the area. I have viewed it only by video call with the agent, who states that other people are interested. My intention is to transfer the £1,500 holding deposit by bank transfer today, before viewing the property in person. I know what I require in terms of rent and layout, I have weighed this flat against those requirements, and I have made my decision. I consult you on every housing and financial decision beforehand, and you have been my point of reference for years. What is your view?
